description: Create a label the board does not have yet, such as "fundraising" when tagging asks for one that is missing. Use it only when the person asks: a board's labels are its own vocabulary, and a near-duplicate splits every later filter. A name the board already has, in any case, is refused with the existing label.

color.description: A colour, as #rrggbb; the palette's next when unset

name.description: The label, as it will read on tickets

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: create_label
title: Create a label
